criteria: published quality improvement over comparable baseline evidence preferred, never cross-dataset score substitution
selection_policy.Image_rationale: All3 shortlisted official ImageNet1K checkpoints improve published ResNet50-v2 ImageNet1K quality; choose one per CNN/ViT/Swin family. No architecture can exceed frozen measured Imagenette baseline accuracy1.0. ConvNeXt-large chosen over base by same published ImageNet metric.
selection_policy.OCR_rationale: No public score establishes superiority on frozen200 crops. Choose mature high-capacity multilingual document/server recognizers at distinct scales and a large Transformer directly pretrained for scene-word recognition. PP-OCRv6 has no public large tier above medium. Full-image pipeline and detection-only models are not candidates; TrOCR is compatible with actual supplied crops. All6 real candidates retained in universe.
